weakest.text: For evaluation and hybrid search, the library does not provide specific details on how to evaluate retrieval and answer quality beyond a generic phase [E27].
Chunking strategies are not detailed beyond general RAG context fit mentions [E2].
The guide suggests comparing them on their own corpus before committing to a specific tool [E3].
For the RAG pipeline architecture, an end-to-end private RAG stack requires specific layers defined by Open-Source tools [E4].

Recommendation:** Prioritize a hybrid search pipeline fused with rank-based fusion (RRF) followed by a local cross-encoder reranker, as pure vector or keyword search alone fails to capture both semantic context and exact terminology [E13][E21].
